log.text: Light Screen up on P2's side

decisions.rationale: Farigiraf's Armor Tail blocks Fake Out & Prankster; Psychic OHKOs Sneasler (breaks Sash). Mega Gardevoir Pixilate Hyper Voice pressures both foes. Noivern provides Tailwind speed mode; Kingambit cleans late with Supreme Overlord. Hatterene benched to avoid Chandelure Imprison lock.
decisions.notebook: Game 1: Armor Tail blocks Prankster priority from foes. Light Screen + resistances make Klefki bulky; combined special attacks still break through. Farigiraf Psychic OHKOs Sneasler. Chandelure carries Imprison+Trick Room — avoid bringing Hatterene into it. Mega Gardevoir Pixilate Hyper Voice is primary spread tool.

decisions.rationale: Lead Chandelure Imprison blocks both Farigiraf and Hatterene Trick Room while active, Mental Herb guards Taunt. Sneasler Throat Chop is SE vs Farigiraf and Close Combat vs Kingambit/Hisui Arcanine, fast enough to pressure before TR. Garchomp provides spread pressure vs Kingambit/H-Arcanine/Hatterene. Klefki Light Clay screens halve Mega Gardevoir Pixilate Hyper Voice and physical attackers.
decisions.notebook: Opp TR core Farigiraf Armor Tail Mental Herb + Hatterene Magic Bounce Life Orb + Mega Gardevoir Pixilate Hyper Voice. Armor Tail blocks priority targeting its side (Fake Out, ExtremeSpeed, Prankster TWave). Hatterene bounces status. Chandelure Imprison+TR hard counters TR while alive. Klefki screens help vs spread Fairy. Burn halves physical but not special. Keep Garchomp+Rotom Levitate synergy in mind for future games.

selection: Trick Room (all adjacent, including ally Gardevoir)
decisions.rationale: Gardevoir Mega Evolves safely behind Protect, nullifying Gunk Shot OHKO and Shadow Ball threats. Farigiraf attempts Trick Room: if Chandelure Imprisons (likely, priority 0 vs -7), Trick Room is blocked but I force the reveal and Farigiraf survives any single Sneasler hit (max ~83%). If they skip Imprison, Trick Room goes up and I dominate. Armor Tail blocks Fake Out, so Sneasler must attack. Turn 2: pivot Farigiraf if Imprisoned, or sweep under Trick Room.
decisions.notebook: Game 2 notes: Chandelure carries Imprison+Trick Room to deny our Trick Room. Armor Tail blocks Prankster and Fake Out. Sneasler has Focus Sash+Unburden; Gunk Shot OHKOs Gardevoir. Farigiraf Psychic OHKOs Sneasler but Sash keeps it at 1HP. Mega Gardevoir Pixilate Hyper Voice is primary spread tool; loses Flash Fire on Mega Evo so must respect Heat Wave. Kingambit 4x weak to Close Combat — avoid switching into Sneasler. Noivern faster than Sneasler, can set Tailwind. Plan: neutralize Chandelure first, then set Trick Room with Farigiraf for endgame.

decisions.rationale: Fake Out blocked by Armor Tail. Sneasler Gunk Shot guaranteed OHKO vs Gardevoir (111-268%). Chandelure Imprison goes first (145 vs 100-132) and blocks Trick Room from both Farigiraf and Gardevoir/Hatterene while active, hard countering their TR core. Sneasler sash survives Farigiraf Psychic.
decisions.notebook: Opp TR core Farigiraf Armor Tail Mental Herb + Hatterene Magic Bounce Life Orb + Mega Gardevoir Pixilate Hyper Voice. Armor Tail blocks priority targeting its side. Hatterene bounces status. Chandelure Imprison+TR hard counters TR while alive. Klefki screens help vs spread Fairy. Keep Garchomp Ground immune synergy. Sneasler Gunk Shot OHKOs Gardevoir.

decisions.rationale: Gardevoir-Mega is outsped and OHKOed by Sneasler Gunk Shot. Switching to Kingambit: Steel typing gives Gunk Shot immunity, Dark resists Shadow Ball (20-29%). Farigiraf Psychic breaks Sneasler's Focus Sash (4x SE, OHKO but Sash). Worst case: Chandelure Heat Wave does 72-102% to Kingambit, but standard Shadow Ball does only 20-29%. Next turn Sucker Punch cleans 1HP Sneasler, Farigiraf pressures Chandelure.
decisions.notebook: Game 2: Chandelure Imprison blocks Trick Room. Sneasler Focus Sash+Unburden; Gunk Shot OHKOs Gardevoir. Armor Tail blocks Fake Out. Kingambit immune to Gunk Shot, resists Shadow Ball. Priority: eliminate Chandelure to free Trick Room, then Farigiraf sets TR for Kingambit endgame. Noivern (192 Spe) faster than Sneasler, can Tailwind if needed.

decisions.rationale: Imprison blocks Psychic/Hyper Voice/TR, so Sneasler is safe from 4x Psychic. Gunk Shot is guaranteed OHKO vs Mega Gardevoir (122-240%) and Shadow Ball adds 56-96% to cover 80% miss chance. Double targeting Gardevoir removes Pixilate spread threat.

Sucker Punch (+1) KOs 1% Sneasler before it can Close Combat OHKO Kingambit. Farigiraf Psychic chips Chandelure 32–59% to pressure Imprison removal. If Sneasler switches, Sucker Punch whiffs but Psychic still lands; Kingambit lives either way. Chandelure Heat Wave does 68–95% to Kingambit and 29–41% to Farigiraf — both survive the spread, enabling a double-target into Chandelure next turn to free Trick Room.
decisions.notebook: Game 2: Chandelure Imprison blocks Trick Room. Sneasler Focus Sash consumed, Unburden active, 1% HP. Priority: eliminate Chandelure to free TR, then Farigiraf sets TR for Kingambit endgame. Kingambit Sucker Punch KOs attacking Sneasler before it moves. Gardevoir-Mega and Noivern in back. Sneasler Close Combat OHKOs Kingambit; must be removed or blocked. Armor Tail blocks Fake Out throughout.

decisions.rationale: Sneasler CC is guaranteed OHKO on Kingambit (139-240%). Kingambit Sucker Punch (+1 prio) would go before Sneasler and can OHKO Chandelure (89-157%) if Chandelure attacks. Using Imprison status makes Sucker Punch fail, ensures Sneasler removes Kingambit first and preserves Imprison lock on Trick Room.
decisions.notebook: Opp TR core Farigiraf Armor Tail Mental Herb + Hatterene Magic Bounce LO + Mega Gardevoir Pixilate. Armor Tail blocks priority vs their side. Chandelure Imprison+TR hard counters TR while alive. Klefki screens vs spread Fairy. Garchomp Ground synergy. Sneasler Gunk Shot OHKOs Gardevoir, CC OHKOs Kingambit.

decisions.rationale: Chandelure 18% will be KOed by Psychic or Sucker Punch. Klefki Prankster is blocked by Farigiraf Armor Tail while it lives, so screens/TWave fail. Garchomp gives immediate offensive pressure, outspeeds both foes (169 vs 70-102), and preserves Klefki for after Farigiraf is gone.
decisions.notebook: Opp TR core Farigiraf Armor Tail Mental Herb + Hatterene Magic Bounce LO + Mega Gardevoir Pixilate. Armor Tail blocks priority vs their side, including Fake Out and Prankster. Chandelure Imprison+TR hard counters TR while alive. Klefki screens vs spread Fairy but useless into Armor Tail. Garchomp Ground synergy, LO. Sneasler Gunk Shot OHKOs Gardevoir, CC OHKOs Kingambit. Lead patterns: Farigiraf+Gardevoir-Mega TR attempt.

decisions.rationale: Kingambit Protects to survive Garchomp's likely Earthquake (55–93% into 77% HP risks KO), while Farigiraf Psychics Chandelure. If Chandelure doesn't Protect, it faints and Imprison ends. If it Protects, the attack is blocked but Kingambit lives and Chandelure's Protect is strained next turn. Farigiraf survives EQ + Heat Wave combined outside extreme rolls.
decisions.notebook: Game 2: Chandelure's Imprison blocks Trick Room. Priority: remove Chandelure to free TR, then Farigiraf sets TR for Kingambit endgame. Gardevoir-Mega and Noivern in back. Armor Tail blocks Fake Out. Sneasler fainted; Unburden consumed. Garchomp Life Orb Jolly; Chandelure fragile at low HP; Rotom-Mow, Klefki, Arcanine in back.

decisions.rationale: Garchomp Rock Slide avoids KOing ally Chandelure while chipping both foes. Chandelure Imprison is status so Kingambit Sucker Punch targeting it fails, guaranteeing Farigiraf cannot Trick Room this turn even though Chandelure will then faint to Psychic. This preserves one extra turn without TR and leaves Farigiraf chipped for a potential KO next turn before TR goes up.
decisions.notebook: Opp TR core Farigiraf Armor Tail Mental Herb + Hatterene Magic Bounce LO + Mega Gardevoir Pixilate. Armor Tail blocks priority vs their side. Chandelure Imprison+TR hard counters TR while alive. Klefki screens vs spread Fairy but useless into Armor Tail. Garchomp LO Ground synergy. Sneasler Gunk Shot OHKOs Gardevoir, CC OHKOs Kingambit. Lead patterns Farigiraf+Gardevoir-Mega TR attempt. Plan: keep Imprison up as long as possible, chip Farigiraf to deny TR next turn, focus Kingambit with Ground/Fire.

decisions.rationale: Farigiraf Psychics Chandelure to force a Protect or KO; Kingambit switches to Noivern, who is immune to Garchomp's EQ and carries Focus Sash for other moves. If Chandelure Protects, it cannot do so next turn and Imprison persists but we preserve Kingambit. If Chandelure switches, Imprison ends and we set Trick Room next turn. Noivern also gives us Tailwind as a secondary speed option.
decisions.notebook: Game 2: Chandelure's Imprison blocks Trick Room. Priority remains removing Chandelure to free TR, then Farigiraf sets TR for Kingambit endgame. Gardevoir-Mega and Noivern in back; Noivern immune to Ground, carries Focus Sash. Garchomp Life Orb Jolly threatens Kingambit with EQ. Rotom-Mow, Klefki, Arcanine unrevealed in opponent's back. Supreme Overlord currently 1 fallen ally (Sneasler). Kingambit at 77% preserved for later; risky to keep it in against Garchomp EQ range.

decisions.rationale: Garchomp EQ is best KO chance vs 77% Kingambit (57-97% + Heat Wave would be lethal but speed order kills ally first). Chandelure at 18% dies to any hit this turn, so preserve Klefki HP by letting Chandelure faint to own EQ rather than switching and taking EQ on Klefki. Using Imprison status makes Kingambit Sucker Punch into Chandelure fail (status vs attack), wasting its priority before EQ lands.
decisions.notebook: Opp TR core Farigiraf Armor Tail Mental Herb + Hatterene Magic Bounce LO + Mega Gardevoir Pixilate. Armor Tail blocks priority vs their side. Chandelure Imprison+TR hard counters TR while alive. Klefki screens vs spread Fairy but blocked by Armor Tail. Garchomp LO Ground synergy. Sneasler Gunk Shot OHKOs Gardevoir, CC OHKOs Kingambit. Lead patterns Farigiraf+Gardevoir-Mega TR attempt. Plan: keep Imprison up as long as possible, chip Farigiraf to deny TR next turn, focus Kingambit with Ground/Fire.

decisions.rationale: Automatic: only one legal joint action.

Farigiraf Protects to survive in case Draco Meteor misses, enabling Trick Room later. Noivern's Draco Meteor KOs Garchomp before it acts, leaving only Klefki. Opponent only brought 4 mons; eliminating Garchomp secures the game.
decisions.notebook: Game 2: Imprison ended with Chandelure fainting; Trick Room is now usable. Opponent brought only 4 Pokémon: Sneasler, Garchomp, Chandelure, Klefki. After KOing Garchomp, only Klefki remains. Kingambit Supreme Overlord +20% (2 fallen). Plan: set Trick Room with Farigiraf next and sweep with Kingambit.

selection: Light Screen (your side, including ally Garchomp)
decisions.rationale: Garchomp Dragon Claw on Farigiraf secures KO from 30% with Life Orb (27-62% base) to deny Trick Room now that Imprison is gone. Klefki Light Screen is not blocked by Armor Tail (targets own side) and halves Noivern Draco/Heat Wave to let 40% Garchomp survive the 1v1 after Farigiraf dies. Rock Slide spread is weaker vs Farigiraf and risks missing the KO.
decisions.notebook: Opp TR core is Farigiraf Armor Tail Mental Herb + Hatterene Magic Bounce LO + Mega Gardevoir Pixilate. Armor Tail blocks Prankster status targeting their side, so Thunder Wave vs foes fails while Farigiraf is active. Chandelure Imprison hard counters TR while alive. Sneasler Gunk Shot OHKOs Gardevoir, CC OHKOs Kingambit. Lead pattern Farigiraf+Gardevoir-Mega TR attempt. Plan: keep Imprison up, chip Farigiraf to deny TR, focus Kingambit with Ground/Fire. Klefki screens work vs spread but need to be set before TR.

selection: Trick Room (all adjacent, including ally Noivern)
decisions.rationale: Trick Room secures the endgame: Farigiraf sets it at -7 priority while Noivern chips Klefki with Heat Wave. Armor Tail blocks Klefki's Prankster status moves, so only Dazzling Gleam threatens. Farigiraf may faint (9.7-36.9% from 30%), but even if it does, Kingambit enters free and cleans up with Iron Head. If Trick Room goes up, Kingambit sweeps under it next turn.
decisions.notebook: Game 2: Imprison ended with Chandelure fainting; Trick Room is now usable. Opponent brought only 4 Pokémon: Sneasler, Garchomp, Chandelure, Klefki. After KOing Garchomp, only Klefki remains. Kingambit Supreme Overlord +20% (2 fallen). Plan: set Trick Room with Farigiraf and sweep with Kingambit. Armor Tail blocks Prankster status moves from Klefki.

decisions.rationale: Farigiraf at 30% blocks Prankster TWave via Armor Tail, so status fails. Light Screen already active 7 turns, Reflect useless vs special attackers. Only Dazzling Gleam can chip Farigiraf to remove Armor Tail and pressure Noivern (2x).
decisions.notebook: Opp TR core Farigiraf Armor Tail Mental Herb + Hatterene Magic Bounce LO + Mega Gardevoir Pixilate. Armor Tail blocks Prankster status vs their side while Farigiraf active. Chandelure Imprison counters TR. Sneasler Gunk Shot OHKOs Gardevoir, CC OHKOs Kingambit. Lead pattern Farigiraf+Gardevoir-Mega TR. Kingambit Black Glasses Adamant Supreme Overlord with Kowtow Sucker IronHead Protect. Noivern Focus Sash Timid Infiltrator Tailwind Draco HeatWave Protect -2 SpA after Draco.

decisions.rationale: Farigiraf at 16% dies to Dazzling Gleam; switch to Kingambit who is immune to Prankster TWave and resists Fairy. Noivern Heat Wave chips Klefki through Light Screen despite -2 SpA. Under TR next turn, Kingambit (70 Spe) moves before Klefki (95-127) and Iron Head with Supreme Overlord +30% threatens KO. Gardevoir-Mega in back secures cleanup.
decisions.notebook: Game 2: Only Klefki remains. Trick Room active (4 turns). Kingambit Supreme Overlord +30% (3 fallen: Sneasler, Chandelure, Garchomp). Armor Tail blocks Prankster only while Farigiraf is on field. Kingambit immune to Prankster TWave anyway. Iron Head neutral into Klefki; Kowtow Cleave NVE. Gardevoir-Mega Mystical Fire SE. Plan: switch Farigiraf→Kingambit, chip with Noivern, then Iron Head under TR for KO.

decisions.rationale: Klefki is last mon vs Farigiraf 15% + Noivern 58% sash -2 under TR with Light Screen up. Armor Tail blocks Prankster TWave while Farigiraf alive, so only Dazzling Gleam can KO Farigiraf (11.5-25.6% max range vs 15% current) and damage Noivern before it moves last in TR.
decisions.notebook: Opp TR core Farigiraf Armor Tail Mental Herb + Hatterene Magic Bounce LO + Mega Gardevoir Pixilate. Armor Tail blocks Prankster status while Farigiraf active. Chandelure Imprison counters TR. Sneasler Gunk Shot OHKOs Gardevoir, CC OHKOs Kingambit. Kingambit Black Glasses Adamant Supreme Overlord Kowtow Sucker IronHead Protect. Noivern Focus Sash Timid Infiltrator Tailwind Draco HeatWave Protect. Lead pattern Farigiraf+Gardevoir-Mega TR. Plan: preserve Imprison early, pressure Gardevoir with Sneasler, keep Klefki screens for endgame.

decisions.rationale: Kingambit Iron Head into Klefki under TR: 36-68.9% range, possible OHKO at high roll. Switch Noivern (14%, -2 SpA, would faint to Dazzling Gleam) to Gardevoir-Mega (100%). Klefki's Dazzling Gleam hits Kingambit (14-27%) and Gardevoir (10-24%), easily survived. Next turn Iron Head + Mystical Fire guarantees KO even through Light Screen. Burn chip adds pressure. Noivern preserved for cleanup if needed.
decisions.notebook: Game 2: Only Klefki remains. Trick Room active (3 turns). Kingambit Supreme Overlord +30% (3 fallen). Gardevoir-Mega in back. Plan: Iron Head + Mystical Fire next turn secures win. Light Screen still up ~5 turns.

decisions.rationale: Dazzling Gleam guarantees KO on 13% Noivern (25-56% range) even spread, removing Heat Wave pressure. Light Screen already up vs special, burn tick manageable. Killing Noivern now reduces to 1v1 vs Kingambit under TR, letting us set Reflect next turn vs remaining physical threats.
decisions.notebook: Opp core Farigiraf Armor Tail Mental Herb + Hatterene Magic Bounce LO + Mega Gardevoir Pixilate Modest. Kingambit Black Glasses Adamant Supreme Overlord Kowtow Sucker IronHead Protect. Noivern Focus Sash Timid Infiltrator Tailwind Draco HeatWave Protect. Lead Farigiraf+Gardevoir-Mega TR. Armor Tail blocks Prankster status while Farigiraf active. Chandelure Imprison fails vs TR if Farigiraf flinch? Actually Imprison failed earlier. Sneasler Gunk Shot OHKOs Gardevoir, CC OHKOs Kingambit. Keep Klefki screens for endgame.

decisions.rationale: Iron Head (36% min) and Mystical Fire (29.9% min through Light Screen) both always KO 10% Klefki. Kingambit moves first under Trick Room; even if Prankster Thunder Wave paralyzes it, Gardevoir's Mystical Fire secures the KO. Two attacks remove all risk.
decisions.notebook: Game 2: Only Klefki remains at 10% brn. Trick Room 2 turns. Kingambit Supreme Overlord +3 (3 fallen). Both Iron Head and Mystical Fire KO ranges guarantee the win; no need to preserve resources.

decisions.rationale: Klefki at 10% dies to any hit. Dazzling Gleam lets Kingambit Sucker Punch KO. Status makes Sucker fail, forcing Iron Head which can be fully paralyzed (25%). Light Screen already up halves Gardevoir Hyper Voice to ~5-8% possible survive, while Mystical Fire still KOs. TWave Kingambit gives only out to survive turn and force game 3.
decisions.notebook: Opp: Farigiraf ArmorTail MentalHerb Sassy TR Psychic HyperVoice Protect, Hatterene MagicBounce LO Quiet TR Psychic Dazzling Protect, Mega Gardevoir Pixilate Modest HyperVoice Psychic MysticalFire Protect, Kingambit BlackGlasses Adamant SupremeOverlord Kowtow Sucker IronHead Protect, Noivern FocusSash Timid Infiltrator Tailwind Draco HeatWave Protect, Hisui Arcanine Intimidate Sitrus not seen. Lead Farigiraf+Gardevoir TR. ArmorTail blocks Prankster while active. Sneasler Gunk OHKOs Gardevoir, CC OHKOs Kingambit. Keep Klefki screens.

reflections.summary: P1 won because P2's Chandelure failed to sustain Imprison (reuse failed) and Garchomp's Earthquake KO'd its own Chandelure, removing the Imprison block and allowing P1 to set Trick Room with Farigiraf. P1's slow Kingambit and Gardevoir-Mega then cleaned up under Trick Room.
reflections.adjustment: If facing a similar Imprison team, lead with Noivern and Gardevoir-Mega to pressure Chandelure immediately, using Draco Meteor or Mystical Fire to KO it before it can Imprison or after its Mental Herb is wasted. Keep Farigiraf and Kingambit in the back to set Trick Room once Chandelure is gone, and use Protect to scout for Imprison attempts.
reflections.notebook: P2's team: Imprison Chandelure (Mental Herb) to block Trick Room; Garchomp (Life Orb, Rough Skin) with EQ, Rock Slide, Dragon Claw, Protect; Klefki (Light Clay) with screens and Thunder Wave; Sneasler (Focus Sash) with Fake Out. P2 misplayed by reusing Imprison while active and EQ'ing own Chandelure. P2 preferred early Light Screen. P2 did not bring Rotom-Mow or Arcanine this game. Future plan: Remove Chandelure quickly with Noivern or Gardevoir-Mega special attacks; use Kingambit's Sucker Punch to pressure; Farigiraf can hold Mental Herb to guarantee Trick Room if Imprison is not active.

reflections.summary: Lost on preview. Brought Chandelure Imprison + Garchomp EQ anti-synergy - Garchomp EQ super-effective KO'd own Chandelure T5 while Noivern immune, Imprison failed T4, leaving no TR stop. Klefki screens core is invalid vs this opp: ArmorTail Farigiraf blocks Prankster, Infiltrator Noivern bypasses screens and burns with Heat Wave, Pixilate HyperVoice hits through. Sneasler that OHKOs Mega Gardevoir with Gunk and Kingambit with CC was not active to deny TR.
reflections.adjustment: Don't pair Chandelure with Earthquake Garchomp. Next game drop Chandelure/Klefki vs ArmorTail+Infiltrator+HyperVoice. Lead Sneasler Fake Out to stop Farigiraf TR and Gunk Shot Mega Gardevoir, keep Garchomp on Rock Slide/Protect not EQ, or bring non-EQ spread answer to Gardevoir/Noivern/Kingambit.
reflections.notebook: Opp: Farigiraf ArmorTail MentalHerb Sassy TR Psychic HyperVoice Protect, Hatterene MagicBounce LO Quiet TR Psychic Dazzling Protect not brought G2, Mega Gardevoir Pixilate Modest HyperVoice Psychic MysticalFire Protect, Kingambit BlackGlasses Adamant SupremeOverlord Kowtow Sucker IronHead Protect, Noivern FocusSash Timid Infiltrator Tailwind Draco HeatWave Protect, Hisui Arcanine Intimidate Sitrus unseen. Tendency: lead Farigiraf+Gardevoir or Farigiraf+Kingambit, Protect stall with Kingambit, pivot Noivern to immune EQ and Draco Garchomp, delay TR until after threats removed, Infiltrator Heat Wave to burn Klefki. ArmorTail blocks Prankster while active. Plan: Sneasler Fake Out + Gunk OHKO Gardevoir, CC OHKO Kingambit is primary TR denial; avoid EQ with own Ghost, avoid Klefki screens into Infiltrator/HyperVoice.
